identityTest.stableIdentity: A governed grading framework remains identifiable independently of people, positions, assignments and compensation while its level semantics evolve through immutable releases.
identityTest.versionIdentity: Any change to axes, levels, ordering, applicability or crosswalk semantics creates a successor scheme version.

invariants: Every level pins one scheme version.
A scheme version is immutable after publication.
Grade levels are scheme-version-owned members, not independent roots.
Crosswalks pin source and target scheme versions.
Crosswalk loss is declared and unmappable is explicit.
Grade, proficiency, performance, qualification and compensation remain distinct.
Missing grade is unknown rather than a default.
Scheme changes do not mutate people, positions or pay.
